g.text: Who you are on the air.
Your callsign with SSID. Also changeable any time with Ctrl+K.
Extra callsigns this station accepts connections on, comma
separated -- a personal mailbox on -1, for instance.
Which TNC or modem kissterm talks to. Changing this reopens the connection, so disconnect
first. USB and serial TNCs are noticed automatically when you plug them in; scanning the
network is manual, because a sweep is around 1500 connection attempts and does not belong
